text:
**Atlas (2024 film)** centers on the escalating conflict between humanity and advanced artificial intelligence. In 2043, a humanoid AI terrorist named Harlan initiates a war of machines against humans, forcing the military forces of a new International Coalition of Nations (ICN) to drive him into outer space. Twenty-eight years later, in 2071, Atlas Shepherd, an analyst who distrusts AI and is the daughter of Harlan's designer, begins a search for the fugitive.
Atlas joins a military mission to the Andromeda Galaxy with AI-assisted mecha known as ARCs. After surviving an attack and crash-landing, Atlas bonds with the onboard AI, Smith, and reluctantly interfaces her mind with Smith for greater control. Harlan ultimately lures the military to the planet to steal a ship and its carbon bombs, intending to destroy Earth's atmosphere. Atlas and Smith defeat Harlan in hand-to-hand combat after securing the necessary codes, and Atlas is later informed that her mother was killed by Harlan.
